retained_text.facts: The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking to quash the order no.138 dated 02.01.2024 under Annexure-5, by which corrigendum has been issued extending time for receipt of application for registration as approved suppliers for supply of principal food grains and other misc. articles.
retained_text.arguments: At that point of time, a corrigendum was issued under Annexure-5 dated 02.01.2024 extending the time limit for receipt of application for registration as approved suppliers for supply of principal food grains and other misc. articles, which cannot be sustained in the eye of law.

retained_text.facts: This writ petition has been filed challenging the order dated 06.09.2024, thereby sealed the premises of the petitioner's hotel on the ground that the petitioner is running the hotel without license and also sold banned tobacco products. While being so, on inspection, it was found that the petitioner had sold the tobacco products and seized 3 pockets of banned tobacco products. Therefore, FIR was registered in Crime No.72 of 2024 for the offence under Section 24(1) of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 as against the person who was in occupation. , the second respondent inspected the premises and found that the petitioner has no license to run the hotel and also sold the banned tobacco products in the hotel premises. The FIR was registered as against the tea master and the petitioner is nothing to do with the tobacco products. The petitioner was granted license finally on 29.07.2021 and the same was valid upto 28.07.2022. Further, https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis FIR was registered as against the person who was in charge of the petitioner's hotel in Crime No.72 of 2024 for the offence under Section 24(1) of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, A.Boopathiraja vs The Food Safety Officer on 21 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142448943/ 2 Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003, on the file of the Inspector of Police, Murappanadu Police Station, Thoothukudi District and it is pending for investigation.
